only the simple data. can't pussy foot your way around the truth. it's their fucking data!
Now I’m just a simple country fella. That much is true. Never had no formal schoolin. No book learnin. No fancy smancy edumacation. Had a teacher once. Had her right on her desk (oh baby). That was a true edification. More on that in future posts (lol).
I like libraries though. Big ole elaborate labyrinths if you ask me. I like to walk around in them. Marvel at what humans have been able to produce. Pick up a book here or there. Flip through it. Look at the pictures mostly. Them letters be tough to work through. I ain’t got the smarts for that type of cattle rustle.
Anyway - when you enter a library - the signs always (fucking always) have happy images on it. Usually: books, paper & pencil, inspirational quotes, sometimes equations or formulations, and almost always something along the lines of knowledge is power. Point being - the sign tells you what they have in store for you. You’re going in the fucking library - they got a lot of fucking books for you! Simple.
Now contrast that with the fucking official (god damn official) image of the medical profession.
Now - I know why “they” say - they chose a snake. Guess what? I don’t fucking believe them. If your goal was to actually heal… ask yourself… would you choose a god damn representational image that only confers harm? Only injects poison? Seriously… ask yourself that fucking question. Snakes inject poison into their victims. Check and mate!
Working out here on the range - I’ve put more signs up than you can shake a stick at. And guess what? They all confer to passers by… what they will fucking find there. Bad water, clean water, loose rocks, snakes, scorpions, hornets, steep cliffs, etc. My fucking signs tell people what they can expect. Duh! Like every other sign on planet earth.
The Medical “Profession” is no fucking different. Just we don’t believe our own god damn eyes. Drives me nuts. We will one day. I explained why they fucking do this yesterday: Everything makes sense... if you read it from their viewpoint
It is a physical impossibility for the medical profession to NOT know that vaccines cause cancer.
I’m not gonna jump in the mud with those fucking pigs and wrestle around in their shit. Never get in the mud with fucking pigs.
They know it. We know it. Everyone knows it.
Doesn’t fucking matter what the idiot Main Stream Media chooses to acknowledge. They’re as corrupt as it gets. Like I give a good god damn what those assholes choose to validate. Fuck out here! They’re irrelevant. That’s exactly why you’re here, reading this post, implicitly understanding deep down in your soul, that what I am writing is correct.
The very fact you are here… reading these words… actually validate every word I write. Get it? You physically disregarding all the slop they try to feed you, and searching out someone like me… is the fucking proof what I say is correct. I thank you from the bottom of my heart (truly). We are going to end this fucking nightmare (together)!
Lets get into it:
Simple Conclusion:
You inject posion… you get fucking sick!
Simple shit here man.
By the way - by their own retarded logic - all our grandparents, our older aunts & uncles, probably a lot of our older parents, and those of us lucky enough to be born before this nightmare went into overdrive - SHOULD ALL BE FUCKING DEAD!
If they didn’t get any of this shit… why are they so fucking healthy? Why do we all know older relatives that lived easily into their 90’s? Explain that shit to me please.
Why did US cancer rates not explode while the vast majority of our population were lifelong smokers? Why does the cancer chart move in unison to the vaccine schedule? How can childhood cancer rates (the most brutal shit on earth) correlate perfectly to the childhood vaccine schedule? Come on now man. Just use your own eyes.
If you’re not outraged after reading this post…check your fucking pulse… you’re dead inside!
